svg.text: Look sheet · on SLAB
Round 2 (R9) · the same SLAB at real proportions in four looks · 1 mm = 6 px
Same instrument, same panel, four material and colour directions, so the looks can be judged like for like.
The owner letters or paints the legends himself (owner.md Q5): Kalam here is only a stand-in.
Every look uses bought knobs and caps; the colours come from the bought cap, paint, or the laser-cut body.
Checked against owner.md Q5 ("id have to see mocks of the ideas to tell you which look appeals") · scores.md R9, R4 · eng v2 §5 (enclosure ≈ $30–80)
Hand-lettered legends, wordmark, grille pattern and paintings are PLACEHOLDERS: the owner letters or paints the real ones.
Field
warm-grey felt-faced ply stack · black panel · gold rules · orange cutoff
edge, as cut (side, 1 mm = 4 px)
Quiet, soft, bag-friendly. Felt edges hide knocks.
Proof
walnut ply body · cream panel, black legends · red cutoff
edge, as cut (side, 1 mm = 4 px)
Warm, furniture-like, his walnut built-ins. Watch: walnut + big left knob reads 'Moog' (R4/R6).
Desk
smoked acrylic stack · black panel · green cutoff
edge, as cut (side, 1 mm = 4 px)
Studio object, glows at night through the edges. Shows fingerprints.
Cork
cork-faced body · white panel · acid-chartreuse cutoff (MOTTO's draw, tried on SLAB)
edge, as cut (side, 1 mm = 4 px)
The odd one: soft, light, warm to hold, and nobody will call it a clone.
